subject: Television & Streaming
title: Jesse Armstrong and Power Without Merit
description: A quick win: understand Jesse Armstrong and Power Without Merit.

hook.text: Succession followed a billionaire family fighting over a media empire. Every character was awful. Everyone watched.

buildup.text: Jesse Armstrong drew from real dynasties—the Murdochs, the Redstones—to create the Roys, a family rotted by wealth.

discovery.text: The show's genius was its language. Characters weaponized words. Every conversation was a battle for dominance.

twist.text: Armstrong ended the show after four seasons at its peak.

climax.text: Succession defined the final era of prestige HBO—a show about people who have everything except the ability to love.

punchline.text: The most powerful family on TV couldn't fix itself.

quiz.question: What real-world figures inspired the Roy family in Succession?
